summary: Docs audit 2: split multi-topic docs into index plus sidecar folders
author: pm
body:
Per the global docs standard, a doc with several standalone topics becomes `topic.md` (one line per entry: path, what, WHEN) plus `topic/<entry>.md`; cohesive docs get a Contents block and an assessment line instead.

**Done when:** each split doc's index resolves and every reference is repaired.

Source: user request 2026-11-23 (docs audit); standard ~/.claude/docs/documentation_standards.md.
